English.Char_Desc_250: NikPak is a fast archiver for Windows, macOS and Linux. It compresses with Zstandard, LZMA2 and PPMd, encrypts with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305, splits archives into volumes and builds self-extracting .exe files.
English.Char_Desc_450: NikPak is a fast archiver for Windows, macOS and Linux. It compresses with Zstandard, LZMA2 and PPMd and recompresses the Deflate streams inside Office files, PDF and gzip for better ratios. Archives are encrypted with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305, can be split into volumes or built as a self-extracting .exe, and may carry a cover picture.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
NikPak is a fast, encrypted archiver for the .nik archive format, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
It compresses with Zstandard, LZMA2 and PPMd, choosing per block: binary data goes through LZMA2, text through PPMd, and lower levels use multi-threaded Zstandard. Office documents (docx, xlsx, pptx), PDF and .gz files are already Deflate-compressed inside, so NikPak decodes those inner streams, compresses the plain content better and rebuilds the original streams bit for bit on extraction.
Files are compressed on all cores, and an archive can be split into volumes or turned into a self-extracting .exe that unpacks on a machine with nothing installed. Encryption is Argon2id key derivation with XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption. You can attach a cover picture and a legal statement that everyone must accept before extracting.
The package also contains unNik, a free archive browser that opens .nik archives on any machine: browse folders, search, view text and extract. unNik is free for everyone, forever, with no registration.
NikPak is shareware: free for private individuals without a time limit, with one licence per seat for companies. It is written in Rust and ships as a native window on Windows, macOS and Linux.
